title: Onlookers say botched Texas prison execution is like nothing they have ever seen
summary_full: Reinaldo Dennes’ execution took more than an hour as workers struggled to find suitable veinsAn observer of the botched execution of Texas prisoner Reinaldo Dennes this week has said the effects of the lethal injection were like nothing he’d ever seen before.The execution of Dennes at the Huntsville unit of the Texas department of criminal justice took more than an hour as the team managing the procedure struggled to find suitable veins in which to administer the injection to the prisoner.
